long_description.before:
Our platform fixes construction's broken supply chain. 70% of construction projects finish late or over budget; procuring and managing building materials is the number 1 reason why. 

We use LLMs to buy and manage building materials for large construction companies.
With DigiBuild, construction contractors can find, order, track and manage their materials from the supplier to the job site. We help customers save money, staff time, and improve construction project schedules.

We work with the top real estate developers, general contractors, and subcontractors in the US. We manage billions in building material volume annually in the 2nd largest market in the world.
long_description.after:
Advanced materials and disaster intelligence for buildings and critical infrastructure.

Every building represents years of work. A home holds a family’s savings. A business supports livelihoods. Infrastructure keeps communities operating.

DigiBuild is expanding its work in construction technology to help protect those places.

We are bringing together protective-material development, storm intelligence and our experience working across the construction industry. Our initial focus is wildfire resilience and severe weather, with a longer-term opportunity to serve industrial facilities and critical infrastructure.

The industry leader in supply chain moves into Physical AI.

one_liner.after: Physical AI solutions that Protect What We Build.

long_description.before:
Elip sends you the jobs a friend would send you, and gives a company the shortlist a friend would write.

For people: add your resume and say what you want and what you'd never take. Each morning Elip reads millions of jobs from across the internet with that in mind. It sets aside what you said no to and sends the few that fit, each with why and what's missing. Some mornings, none. When one is right, Elip rewrites your resume for that role and you approve every change. Free.

For companies: tell Elip the role. Within minutes you get a short list of people who fit, each with the reason. You meet once they say yes, and pay 10% of first-year base salary only when you hire. Nobody can pay to appear on a shortlist.

Where Elip is going: a world where nobody has to start from zero with a stranger.

Elip is based in San Francisco.
long_description.after:
Good matches have reasons.

A title leaves things out. "More responsibility" can mean leading a team, or owning the work without managing anyone. Your resume says what you've done. Elip asks what you want to do next.

For people: add your resume and say what you want and what you'd never take. Each morning Elip reads millions of jobs with that in mind and sends the ones a friend who knows you would send, each with why. When you change, the search changes with you. Free.

For companies: add a role in your own words. Within minutes you get a short list of people who want that kind of work, each with the reason in plain words. You meet once they say yes, and pay 10% of first-year base salary only when you hire. Nobody can pay to appear on a shortlist.

Where Elip is going: a world where nobody has to start from zero with a stranger.

Elip is based in San Francisco.

long_description.before:
Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code and Codex. Meetings get recorded, notes get written, agents run for hours and leave behind traces nobody reads. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more - alongside meetings, notes, and email from tools like Granola, Read AI, Plaud, and Obsidian. Everything a team produces with AI flows into one place and compounds over time.

Nessie turns that raw, heterogeneous data into an ontology: the live state of a company. Not a static schema but a continuously updated record of what the company knows, what it has decided, who owns what, and how its thinking has evolved, kept current as new work flows in. It is queryable from any agent through our CLI, MCP connector, and plugins, shareable across a team with real permissions, and deployable on-prem for organizations that need it.

Then the loop closes. Once a company’s state is legible to its agents, every agent run becomes training signal: which skills worked, which failed, which workflows keep repeating. Nessie feeds that signal back as reviewable improvements to the skills, prompts, and processes the team runs on. This is what makes a company recursive: its agents get better from its own history, the people working with them get better too, and the compounding never stops.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents that are powerful but amnesiac. Nessie is the layer that gives them, and the humans steering them, a shared memory. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. We are building it.

Founded by two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers in San Francisco. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more.

https://nessielabs.com
long_description.after:
Nessie is shared context for all of your AI tools. It automatically syncs your conversations and agent sessions from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity and 20+ other tools into one place, so you, your team and your agents can search and build on everything you've worked through with AI.

If you use more than one AI tool, you know the problem. Claude doesn't know what you decided in ChatGPT. Codex doesn't know what Claude Code already tried. Every new session starts from zero. With Nessie, you can ask any agent what you decided about a project, what you already tried for a bug, or what a teammate concluded last week, and it answers from your actual history.

Install the app on Mac, Windows or Linux and connect your AI tools, plus meeting and note apps like Granola, Read AI, Plaud and Obsidian. Nessie keeps syncing in the background, and agents reach it through our MCP server, CLI and plugins.

For teams, Nessie turns everyone's AI work into shared knowledge. Share sessions with a teammate or the whole team, and every agent starts from what the team already knows: what was decided, what was tried, and why. Nessie is SOC 2 certified and runs as SaaS, on-prem or BYOC.

For leaders, Nessie is observability across every AI tool your team uses, not one vendor's dashboard. See which skills and workflows actually succeed, what each one costs, and who is getting results, then double down on what works. That's ROI measured on outcomes, not just tokens.

Where we're going: AI-native companies will run thousands of agents that are powerful but forget everything. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. Nessie is that shared memory, and it gets better as your company's own history grows.

Founded by two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers in San Francisco. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more.

one_liner.before: The shared context layer for recursive companies.
one_liner.after: Shared context across ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor and more

long_description.before:
Corvera (YC W26) is the AI sales agent for CPG brands. We turn the data a brand already has into the actions its sales team takes today.

A CPG brand sells into tens of thousands of independent US stores through dozens of distributors, and works that base with a handful of people. CLEAN Cause, a $20M yerba mate brand, covers 21,000 stores through 46 distributors with a four-person sales team. The accounts worth a call are not capped by headcount. The team is.

CLEAN Cause now runs its daily sales decisions on Corvera: 5,000 queries in 40 days across 12 users, $250K of opportunities surfaced within days, and a 7x return on the analysts they would otherwise hire.

With Corvera in place, every sales rep starts the morning with:
- The stores to act on today, ranked and priced, with the reason on the row,
- The outreach already drafted to the right contact at the right distributor, and
- The follow-up booked, logged, and measured against the goal it was set to move.

All from the distributor feeds, retailer portals, and ERP data they already have, resolved into one context layer - without a data team, and without handing their sales to a broker.

We’re founded by Chris (2x Founder; ex-CEO at Better Nature; Forbes 30U30), Dirk (ex-Google Data & AI Lead), and Matthew (ex-Head of Product at Rosemark; Princeton MEng in CS).

To date, we’ve raised $6.2M and are backed by YC, firstminute capital, 6 Degrees Capital, 20VC, Rebel Fund, Duke Capital Partners, and more. Our ICP is US CPG brands doing $20M+ in retail revenue through UNFI, KeHE and DSD distributors. We sell to VPs of Sales and CEOs.

The incumbents prove the scale. Brokers take 5-12% of a $350B US independent grocery market, and Advantage Solutions, a publicly traded company, does $3.5B in annual revenue.

Our mission is bold: to enable the next generation of unicorn CPG brands to be run by teams of less than 10 people.

Our vision is even bolder: to give every CPG brand the coverage of a full sales team at a fraction of the headcount, and displace the broker network that covers the US independent channel today.

Visit www.corvera.ai to learn more!

long_description.before: GodHands learns how your teams actually work from the apps they already use, capturing the steps, decisions and exceptions that never get written down. It turns them into knowledge and playbooks, and builds agents that do the work the same way. Teams use GodHands to run operations, onboard new hires, hand over roles, integrate acquisitions and automate repetitive work.
long_description.after:
Analysts keep working real cases in the tools they already use. GodHands learns each decision and the reason behind it, then builds agents that work the next alerts the same way and keep learning as the rules change. There are no integrations and no specs to write: agents go live in weeks.

At BlitzQuant, a high-frequency trading firm, agents now resolve 90% of live risk alerts without human review, and the team handles 3x the alerts with the same people.

We start with fraud investigations, AML and KYC, and trade surveillance, then expand to every operations team.

one_liner.before: Turn how your team works into playbooks and agents.
one_liner.after: Fraud, risk and compliance agents that learn by watching analysts

We begin with growing ultra-high purity diamond wafers for advanced hardware. Used in data centers, spacecrafts, RF systems, and quantum hardware, our diamond moves heat up to 5× better than copper, helping critical systems run cooler, faster, and more reliably. 

Diamond has spent centuries as a symbol. We are turning it into infrastructure.

long_description.before: Florin is a full-stack insurance carrier where a model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks. The team is ex-Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Terrafirma, and the bet is that a carrier built this way wins on loss ratio, speed, and cost at the same time.

Munito is an open-model inference provider for Europe, private by default. Its API lets users choose their models and keep inference and storage in the EU. 
Founded by the former inference lead at Mistral AI, Munito is built on one belief: open and independent intelligence, both models and inference, is key to economic growth and prosperity.
long_description.after:
Munito AI is the open-model AI cloud for Europe, private by default.
Its API lets users choose their models and keep inference and storage in the EU. We started with inference, on a stack designed to improve itself, and we now add the foundation of an agent cloud: cloud computers, persistent state and documents.
Our goal is to power agentic applications in critical industries, from the office to the factory floor, on our cloud or on-premises.

Founded by the former inference lead at Mistral AI, Munito AI is built on one belief: open and independent intelligence, both models and inference, is key to economic growth and prosperity.

long_description.before:
Helios is building a molecular body test from a single drop of blood. Our at-home test measures more than 1,000 biomarkers and turns them into a living model of the body—designed to show what is happening now, surface risk earlier, and become more useful with every test.

By combining longitudinal molecular data with labs, wearables, health records, and outcomes, we are building toward a world model of human biology. Our goal is to simulate all of human health and use that intelligence to help people perform, recover, and live longer.

long_description.before:
Ordo is rebuilding lab software for the AI era.

The next generation of lab software will be a workforce scientists direct. We’re building it for regulated labs.

Our agents analyze instrument data, apply each lab’s quality rules and draft source-linked reports. We have paid pilots and have cut a 40-hour post-analysis workflow to four hours, including scientist review.

Our ambition is for labs to grow their capacity by deploying agents, without multiplying manual work.

Agents do the work, scientists sign.

long_description.before:
Kairox Systems combines the speed of aerial drones and the stealth of underwater drones into one vehicle. We can look for mines in a strait, fly out of the water to inspect a coastline, and then engage maritime threats in one go. 

Joel, Alex, and Jorge all met at MIT. After conversations with warfighters and drone researchers, they decided to create a vehicle unlike any before: A long-range vehicle that is truly amphibious, low-cost enough for one-way swarms, can operate fully autonomously, and can be repurposed on the front lines. Engaged with the Marine Corps and validated with end users across the U.S. and allied militaries.

long_description.before:
Streamline Systems is building the replacement for GPS. 

Satellite positioning has become the single point of failure for almost every modern system, both military and civil. We've built the replacement. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. 

We have secured over $80k in contracted revenue to supply our navigation modules for the Pentagon's $1.1bn Drone Dominance Program.
